title: 757 UFO Reports Reached The Pentagon In One Year
hook: The Pentagon received 757 UFO reports, mostly from government observers.
closing: More UFO reports can mean better reporting, not more alien visitors.
question: Have you ever seen something unexplained?

segments.say: The Pentagon's UFO office received 757 new reports, nearly tripling the previous count.
Government air traffic controllers filed 392 UFO reports, more than every other source combined.
Only 21 UFO reports remained genuinely unexplained, separating mystery from the much larger pile.
